info.execTime is now validated as a native decimal string or nonnegative safe integer before identity proof comparison. Arrays, boxed objects, custom conversion hooks, unsafe numbers and null cannot manufacture a proven fill identity. Hyperliquid requires both parsed identifiers to be non-null before equality; exact large strings and leading zeros retain existing spelling. Invalid proof remains unproven and existing persistence/backfill handles it without inventing raw evidence.
